parole.significato: An adherent of an urban subculture of males aged between about 13 and 25, typically but not necessarily of Middle Easte…
parole.testo: From South Levantine Arabic تعال لهون (taʕāl la-hōn, “come here”); cf. Maltese talahawn. The expression became popularized in August 2022 by the Syrian rapper Hassan Tammo, with the track “Ta3la hon” (see quote).
